children: Greenland Energy notified shareholders and warrant holders of UK City Code disclosure requirements related to its potential offer for 80 Mile.
Issued press release on Sept 9, 2026 to satisfy UK City Code notice obligations for potential offer for 80 Mile.
Confirms 43,730,194 shares outstanding and 17,500,000 warrants (strike $5, expiring Apr 29, 2031).
Explains Rule 8.3 Opening Position and Dealing disclosure obligations for anyone ≥1% interest in relevant securities.
Provides Takeover Panel contact and will post announcement on company website by next business day per Rule 26.1.
